purpose: Correct the Black Hole Museum viewport breakout by carrying forward the root-level strategy proven in test/repo-layout-lab.
rootCause: The initial museum stylesheet moved viewport breakout responsibility from the Edublogs mount root to the rendered .bhm-museum child. That diverged from the previously validated layout laboratory and remained constrained by the theme ancestry.

knownGoodAuthority.contract: The mount root owns width:100vw, left:50%, margin-left:-50vw, margin-right:-50vw, and transform:none.

delivery.strategy: Commit-pinned patch stylesheet imports the already-verified immutable .2 stylesheet and then applies the proven root-level breakout contract. Existing .2 JavaScript, content, experience data, and media remain unchanged.
